facebook.text: Framed, semi-frameless, or frameless? Framed is budget-friendly. Semi-frameless cleans up the look. Frameless disappears entirely and lets your tile do the talking. The right answer depends on your bathroom, your budget, and how you use the space — and that's a 10-minute conversation with us. Start here: floridaglassco.com/services/glass-shower/
